meta.title: Work order WO-2026-0282: CN-TFG, annual inspection

elements.text: Anfa Aero Services: work order WO-2026-0282
Annual inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(a) and the scope and detail of 14 CFR Part 43 Appendix D, using the Cessna 172 inspection checklist.
ELT inspected per 14 CFR 91.207(d): installation, battery date, operation, and radiated signal.
Changed engine oil and filter per the Technify maintenance manual. Gearbox oil level checked.
Discrepancy: Elevator trim tab free play at the limit. Corrective action: Replaced trim tab actuator rod end bearings; free play within limits.
Discrepancy: Left cabin door seal torn. Corrective action: Replaced left cabin door seal.
Aircraft found airworthy after correction of the discrepancies listed.
Certification: the work above was performed in accordance with 14 CFR Part 43 and the procedures manual. The aircraft is airworthy for the work performed.
Return to service: K. Bennani, licence MA-B1-0212
